enum.name: SZ_LCID
enum.description: SZ-Link logical channel, carried in the LCID byte of every SZ-Link frame. Lower values have higher QoS priority.

entry.name: SZ_LCID_RC
entry.description: RC uplink (SZ_RC_CMD), 50-150 Hz, latency below 20 ms.

entry.name: SZ_LCID_TELEMETRY
entry.description: Telemetry: standard SZLink messages (HEARTBEAT, GPS_RAW_INT, SYS_STATUS, ATTITUDE, BATTERY_STATUS, ...).

enum.name: SZ_SEC_FLAGS
enum.description: Flags carried in the SEC byte of every SZ-Link frame. Bits 1-2 hold the key epoch (0-3, the 30 s key ratchet step modulo 4). When SZ_SEC_FLAGS_ENCRYPTED or SZ_SEC_FLAGS_SIGNED is set, an authentication tag (8 bytes on SZ_LCID_RC, 16 bytes otherwise) follows the SEC byte.

entry.name: SZ_SEC_FLAGS_FEC
entry.description: Frame is sent inside a Reed-Solomon FEC envelope (video channel).

entry.name: SZ_SEC_FLAGS_SIGNED
entry.description: Payload is sent in clear but authenticated (signed) with a tag.

entry.name: SZ_PAIR_RESULT_ACCEPTED
entry.description: The ground station is now the paired one; public_key is the vehicle's identity.

entry.name: SZ_PAIR_RESULT_NOT_PAIRING
entry.description: The port is not in pairing mode (set it on the vehicle first).

entry.name: SZ_PAIR_RESULT_BAD_SIGNATURE
entry.description: The request's signature does not match its public key.

entry.name: SZ_PAIR_RESULT_FAILED
entry.description: The vehicle could not store the keys.

enum.name: SZ_VIDEO_CODEC
enum.description: Video codec of the stream carried in SZ_VIDEO_PKT.

entry.name: SZ_VIDEO_PKT_FLAGS_NAL_START
entry.description: Fragment is the first fragment of a NAL unit.

entry.name: SZ_VIDEO_PKT_FLAGS_NAL_END
entry.description: Fragment is the last fragment of a NAL unit.

message.name: SZ_RC_CMD
message.description: RC control command from the ground controller to the vehicle. Sent on SZ_LCID_RC at 50-150 Hz.

message.name: SZ_VIDEO_PKT
message.description: Fragment of an H.264/H.265 NAL unit. Sent on SZ_LCID_VIDEO.
message.field: Index of this fragment within the NAL unit.
Number of fragments in the NAL unit.
Number of valid bytes in data.

message.name: SZ_KEX_INIT
message.description: SZ-Link key exchange, first message (Noise_IK_25519_ChaChaPoly_BLAKE2b, "-> e, es, s, ss" with an 8-byte timestamp payload). Sent by the ground station on SZ_LCID_TELEMETRY, unprotected, to start a session and again about every 10 minutes to rekey.
message.field: Noise handshake message: ephemeral key (32), encrypted static key (48), encrypted timestamp (24).

message.name: SZ_KEX_RESP
message.description: SZ-Link key exchange, second message (Noise_IK "<- e, ee, se"). Sent by the vehicle on SZ_LCID_TELEMETRY, unprotected, in reply to a valid SZ_KEX_INIT from its paired ground station.
message.field: Noise handshake message: ephemeral key (32), authentication tag (16).

message.name: SZ_PAIR_REQUEST
message.description: Pair a ground station with a vehicle. Sent by the ground station on SZ_LCID_TELEMETRY, unprotected. The vehicle accepts it only while disarmed and while the port is in pairing mode, stores public_key as its only ground station and answers with SZ_PAIR_RESPONSE. Identities are Ed25519 keys with EdDSA over BLAKE2b (Monocypher crypto_sign); the SZ_KEX_INIT/SZ_KEX_RESP static keys are converted from them. Compare the fingerprints shown on both sides to rule out a man-in-the-middle during pairing.
message.field: Identity public key of the ground station.
Signature by that key of "SZL pair req" || public_key.

message.name: SZ_PAIR_RESPONSE
message.description: Answer to SZ_PAIR_REQUEST. Sent by the vehicle on SZ_LCID_TELEMETRY, unprotected.
message.field: Identity public key of the vehicle (all zero unless accepted).
When accepted, signature by the vehicle key of "SZL pair resp" || vehicle public_key || ground station public_key; otherwise all zero.
